title: Website Security Price Schedule: Harborline SiteGuard Tiers
content:
Website Security is sold one plan per site in six tiers: Harborline SiteGuard Essentials, Harborline SiteGuard Plus, Harborline SiteGuard Pro, Harborline SiteGuard Business, Harborline SiteGuard Ecommerce and Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise. Each tier is priced per site and per billing term as follows.

| Tier | 12-month term, USD per site | 1-month term, USD per site | Billing terms offered | Hosted-site discount | Sites covered by one plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline SiteGuard Essentials | 23.88 | 2.99 | 1 or 12 months | 15 percent | 1 |
| Harborline SiteGuard Plus | 59.88 | 6.99 | 1 or 12 months | 15 percent | 1 |
| Harborline SiteGuard Pro | 119.88 | 12.99 | 1 or 12 months | 15 percent | 1 |
| Harborline SiteGuard Business | 239.88 | 24.99 | 1 or 12 months | 15 percent | 1 |
| Harborline SiteGuard Ecommerce | 359.88 | 36.99 | 1 or 12 months | 15 percent | 1 |
| Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise | 599.88 | 59.99 | 1 or 12 months | 15 percent | 1 |

## Schedule notes

1. **Term prices.** The 12-month figure is the price per site for a 12-month term; the 1-month figure is the price per site for a 1-month term.
2. **Hosted-site discount.** The hosted-site discount is the percent taken off the term price when the protected site is on a live Harborline hosting plan.
3. **Account tier discount.** On every tier the website security discount percentage of the customer's Harborline account tier may apply instead of the hosted-site discount when it is higher.
4. **Rounding.** On every tier, every computed security amount is rounded half up to the cent.
5. **Tier withheld from sites with included scanning.** Harborline SiteGuard Essentials is withheld from a site whose Harborline hosting plan already includes daily malware scanning. Harborline SiteGuard Plus, Pro, Business, Ecommerce and Enterprise are not withheld on that ground.

| Tier | Account tier discount may apply instead when higher | Withheld from a site whose Harborline hosting plan already includes daily malware scanning | Rounding of computed amounts |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline SiteGuard Essentials | Yes | Yes | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline SiteGuard Plus | Yes | No | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline SiteGuard Pro | Yes | No | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline SiteGuard Business | Yes | No | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline SiteGuard Ecommerce | Yes | No | Half up to the cent |
| Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise | Yes | No | Half up to the cent |

## Reading the schedule

- *Which billing terms can a Website Security plan run on?* The terms offered on every tier are 1 month and 12 months; the schedule lists no other term.
- *How many sites does one plan protect?* One plan covers 1 site on every tier.
- *Do the six tiers differ in their hosted-site discount?* No. The hosted-site discount is 15 percent on every Harborline SiteGuard tier.
